title: poc(helper): recommend helper-style
body:
Following concerns about having search helper users needing to import an extra package in order to use recommend, and leaking backend implementation details in our API, I made this PoC showing how much changes would be needed to wrap recommend in the helper.

This assumes the client has the `getRecommendations` method. Else we would either need to break the constructor, or add an optional argument for the recommendClient last.

I tried as much as possible to match the current API, but putting everything in existing events and/or methods would need much more logic and be less performant.

The only difference for the user would be that **in addition to being able to do** `const result = await helper.getClient().getRecommendations()` they could do : 

```js
helper.addFrequentlyBoughtTogether().recommend();
helper.on('recommendResult', (result) => /* ... */);
```

This actually accentuates implementation details even more.
